release_notes: Release v1.1.42: Comprehensive Settings Dashboard with full control over Appearance & Theme (System, Light, Dark interface modes, and Mushaf Page Dark Mode), Reading & Display options (Keep Screen On toggle, dynamic font scaling with live Page 3 preview, default reader view mode, word meanings on tap), Audio & Recitation defaults (default reciter selector across 6 reciters, offline word pronunciation DB manager), Storage & Cloud sync (cache size inspection & cleaner, Supabase cloud sync status & login), and one-tap update check.
